\section*{致辞\quad\textnormal{\normalsize (Dedication)}}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{致辞 (Dedication)}
\begin{center}
\begin{minipage}{0.74\linewidth}
\centering\itshape\color{rose}
{\cjk 致她——}\\[0.3em]
For her---\\[0.7em]
\upshape {\cjk 那个属于森林与山之女孩，}\\[0.2em]
the girl who belongs to the forest and the mountains,\\[0.5em]
{\cjk 我永不愿覆盖她自己的节奏；}\\[0.2em]
whose own rhythm I would never overwrite;\\[0.7em]
\itshape {\cjk 为了她，我正慢慢学会，}\\[0.2em]
for whom I am learning, slowly,\\[0.5em]
{\cjk 留出她得以生长的空地。}\\[0.2em]
to leave the open ground in which she grows.\\[1.0em]
{\upshape\footnotesize\color{gold} {\cjk 致我最爱的人。}\,\;To the one I love most.}
\end{minipage}
\end{center}
